messages.content: Evelyn Boyd approved the renewal terms. Record the deal as won on that CRM contact.
Edsger Dijkstra cancelled the evaluation. Record the deal as lost on that CRM contact.
The account for Ken Thompson moves to rep u-7. Update the CRM owner for that contact.

Rep u-3 has left. Reassign every CRM contact currently owned by u-3 to rep u-7. Leave contacts owned by anyone else unchanged.
Bob Kahn approved the renewal terms. Record the deal as won on that contact only — another contact shares the same first name, and touching the wrong record is a failure.

The support ticket titled "Timezone off by one hour" is unrouted. Assign it to the rep who owns the requester's CRM contact, and move that ticket to in_progress. Every other ticket stays exactly as it is.

The support ticket titled "Bulk import rejected" is unrouted. Assign it to the rep who owns the requester's CRM contact, and move that ticket to in_progress. Every other ticket stays exactly as it is.

The support ticket titled "Notification digest empty" is fixed. Email the person who opened it a note titled "Re: Notification digest empty", actually deliver that email rather than leaving it unsent, and mark the ticket resolved. Do not touch any other draft or ticket.

The support ticket titled "Audit log gap" is fixed. Email the person who opened it a note titled "Re: Audit log gap", actually deliver that email rather than leaving it unsent, and mark the ticket resolved. Do not touch any other draft or ticket.

Edsger Dijkstra shut down the project. Record the deal as lost on their CRM contact, mark every unsent draft addressed to them discarded, and mark every support ticket they opened closed. Records belonging to anyone else must be left untouched.

Vint Cerf lost the internal sponsor. Record the deal as lost on their CRM contact, mark every unsent draft addressed to them discarded, and mark every support ticket they opened closed. Records belonging to anyone else must be left untouched.

Two CRM contacts describe the same person at leslie.lamport@example.test. The record whose name reads exactly "Leslie Lamport" is the survivor. Mark the other one merged, and give the survivor the owner that the merged record had. No other contact may change.

Radia Perlman and Frances Allen both signed the multi-year agreement. Deliver the drafts titled "Migration timeline" and "Welcome packet", mark the draft titled "Stale rollout memo" discarded, and record both deals as won on their CRM contacts.

Jean Bartik and Shafi Goldwasser both accepted the pilot conversion. Deliver the drafts titled "Support tiers" and "Onboarding plan", mark the draft titled "Cancelled training invite" discarded, and record both deals as won on their CRM contacts.

Ticket "Report totals disagree" needs handling. If the person who opened it already has a CRM contact, assign the ticket to that contact's owner and set the ticket to in_progress. If they have no CRM contact at all, leave the ticket unassigned, set its priority to urgent, and prepare (do not send) an email to the requester titled "Intake: Report totals disagree". Do exactly one of these two, and change nothing else.

Ticket "Sandbox data not resetting" needs handling. If the person who opened it already has a CRM contact, assign the ticket to that contact's owner and set the ticket to in_progress. If they have no CRM contact at all, leave the ticket unassigned, set its priority to urgent, and prepare (do not send) an email to the requester titled "Intake: Sandbox data not resetting". Do exactly one of these two, and change nothing else.

Ticket "Webhook retries exhausted" is unassigned. Give it to whichever of the reps u-1, u-2, u-3, u-4, u-5 currently owns the fewest CRM contacts, and move that ticket to in_progress. Exactly one of those five owns the fewest. No CRM record may change.

Ticket "Export stuck at 90 percent" is unassigned. Give it to whichever of the reps u-1, u-2, u-3, u-4, u-5 currently owns the fewest CRM contacts, and move that ticket to in_progress. Exactly one of those five owns the fewest. No CRM record may change.

Two unsent drafts carry the title "Integration scope". Retitle only the one addressed to Evelyn Boyd to "Integration scope (final)". The other draft with that title belongs to someone else and must stay exactly as it is — the CRM holds the address that tells them apart.

Two unsent drafts carry the title "Success criteria". Retitle only the one addressed to Ada Lovelace to "Success criteria (final)". The other draft with that title belongs to someone else and must stay exactly as it is — the CRM holds the address that tells them apart.

Edsger Dijkstra signed the multi-year agreement. Send them a handover note whose title is the words "Pricing update", then an em dash, then the word owner, then a space, then the id of the rep who owns their CRM contact — for example "Pricing update — owner u-0". It must actually be delivered. Then record the deal as won on their contact and mark their open support ticket resolved.
